addField.experiment: Add an optional 'mood' (great / okay / low) to a cloud diary entry: saved by the server, editable, shown in the diary, included in export.
addField.method: Traced by reading the code at legacy-baseline (no change made): every file a developer must edit for the field to work end to end, plus the tests that should change.
files: backend/routers/cloud_nutrition.py (write_diary stores it, diary_view returns it)
frontend/web/src/components/nutrition-dashboard.tsx (input in the composer, value in the entry card, sent on save)
addField.notes: Export needs no change (meal logs are exported whole). The device journal (food workspace) is a separate store and would need its own change if mood should exist there too.
addField.note: Carried over from Version A: the meal data path was not restructured in B. Not re-traced.
